column4: Added the account model, independent of any sign-in provider.
Added a developer-granted achievement.
Added an append-only record of decisions that matter (approvals, revocations, grants, moderation, ranking corrections).
Added how long to wait before trying a failed send again: doubles each time from 30 seconds up to 6 hours, so a long outage costs a few tries a day, not a stream of them.
Added canonical bytes of a record, for hashing and signing.
Added one immutable version of a piece of community content (a character, a mod, a challenge pack).
Added where each kind of data may live.
Added the wrapper of everything that crosses the client/server boundary: which schema it is, which version of it, and the payload.
Added the ONE door between the game and any server.
Added what the app knows about its player's granted achievements.

Added a generic group of players with roles: the shared building block for anything where people belong together (creator teams, reviewer pools, a mod author's circle, a future clan if one is ever approved).
Added an opaque, typed identifier.
Added ranking as a pure function of server-held records, so any server implementation ranks identically and the result can be re-computed (and audited) at any time.
Added who this installation is, with NO account required.
Added a Gateway that is never connected.
Added what the game wants the server to know, waiting to be sent.

Added keeps the Outbox across app restarts: one line per item in a text file, written to a temporary file and then moved over the old one, so a crash in the middle of saving leaves the previous complete file, never half of a new one.
Added what an actor may be allowed to do on the shared (server-side) systems.
Added a player's report of content, a submission, a profile or another player, for moderators.
Added roles and what they allow, in one table.
Added what a player sends to take part in rankings: a SUMMARY of ONE FINISHED run, nothing else.
Added the wire form of a RunSubmission: plain "key=value" lines.

Added the checks that need no secrets and no server state: they run on the device (so the player gets an immediate, honest "this cannot be submitted because ...") AND on the server (which must never rely on the device having run them).
Added a record that is kept in step between a player's devices (settings, preferences, profile choices - NEVER raw run history or UIMSD data, which are local-only by default; see DataPolicy).
Added how much a record can be believed, and by whom.
Added the public keys the app trusts, each only for the purpose it was published for, with a validity window and a revocation list.
Added checks a signature.

Added community voting primitives: one round has a fixed set of options and an open/close time; each player has at most ONE ballot per round (a new ballot replaces the old one until the round closes, so voting is idempotent and retried sends are harmless).
Added the ONLY place where the player's local run facts are turned into something that could leave the device.
Added reordering the visible columns (plan 3.7): pure list moves, so the rule is the same everywhere and easy to test.
Added the player's own named views: a saved query (QueryCodec text) under a name they chose, so an eleven-condition question is built once.
Added saving, opening and deleting named statistics views.
Added persistent visible-column ordering controls.
Added saving, opening and deleting named statistics views.
